title: fixture bead one
description: The fixture's first bead. It is blocked by fx-2, a child of fx-parent, carries a label and a comment, and is the bead most rows name.

title: fixture bead two
description: The bead fx-1 waits on, so it is ready while fx-1 is blocked.

title: fixture parent

title: fixture agent
description: A bead labeled gt:agent, so a label filter on the agent label has an answer.

title: fixture closed bead
description: A closed bead, so a list that hides closed beads and a count of open ones differ.
